currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes to quote, e.g. USD, GBP, JPY. Leave empty for all currencies the ECB publishes.

baseCurrency.title: Base currency
baseCurrency.description: Rates are expressed as units of each currency per 1 unit of this base. EUR gives official ECB values; any other code uses exact cross rates via EUR.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave both dates empty for the latest rates.
